headline: Northflank breach led to abuse of customers' AI API keys; Linux kernel KEV due today, GitLab and Cisco ASA due tomorrow

bullets.text: New: a Northflank security breach has led to abuse of customers' AI API keys.

Exploited now: the Linux kernel flaw CVE-2026-46300 is due in CISA KEV today, 2026-10-31; GitLab CE/EE CVE-2026-97229 and Cisco ASA/FTD CVE-2026-76418 are due 2026-11-01. Two Ivanti Connect Secure flaws added 2026-10-30 are due 2026-11-02 and 2026-11-13.
Drupal warns that a critical Commerce Core authorization bypass, CVE-2026-118539, is being exploited in attacks.
The official Claude Code extension on the Cursor Marketplace was trojanized with a persistent SSH backdoor; WIRED reports it reached thousands of developer devices.
North Korea-linked hackers are blamed for the record $6.3 billion Binance theft, which Binance links to a compromised DevOps laptop; nearly $3 billion has been frozen.
Breaches: Chainalysis confirms an intrusion into its internal tools that exposed customer identity data; Florida says 4.9 million people had SSNs leaked from its financial aid site.

actions: If you store AI provider API keys in Northflank, rotate them now and review provider usage and billing for abuse.
Apply Linux kernel fixes for CVE-2026-46300 today, and patch GitLab CE/EE (CVE-2026-97229) and Cisco ASA/FTD (CVE-2026-76418) by 2026-11-01.
Patch the two Ivanti Connect Secure flaws CISA added to KEV on 2026-10-30 (due 2026-11-02 and 2026-11-13).
Update Drupal Commerce Core for CVE-2026-118539 and check sites for unauthorized access.
Check Palo Alto firewalls for signs of the PHP2Shell chained compromise, and patch VMware ESX for CVE-2026-41709.
If developers use the Claude Code extension in Cursor, check it against the vendor advisory and look for unexpected SSH keys or services.
